Why is Aura so deathly afraid of her? Tenma finally registers for the martial arts tournament with a familiar (but new!) follower and is thrilled to see even more old friends again, including a certain beautiful knight captain and a mischievous trio of catgirls. The tournament starts off with a bang, but soon tragedy strikes when a formidable competitor seriously injures one of Tenma's dearest friends. Who is this mystery enemy, and will Tenma’s cheat abilities be enough to beat them?

title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent (Light Novel) Vol. 6
author: Yuka Tachibana, Yasuyuki Syuri
description: Sei's life has just returned to a semblance of normal when she's once more summoned to the palace. A foreign prince is coming to the kingdom, ostensibly to study abroad, but his true intentions are shrouded in mystery. In order to protect Sei, the kingdom instructs her to hide her true identity as the Saint and retreat to the safety of the palace. While she complies at first, she soon finds herself drawn to the prince--especially when it becomes clear that she might be the only person who can help him.

title: JK Haru is a Sex Worker in Another World (Manga) Vol. 4
author: Ko Hiratori, J-ta Yamada
description: Transported to another world with her classmate Chiba after an accident, Haru is becoming ever more successful as a sex worker. She gets closer to the fascinating, mysterious man who only comes in on rainy days, but her relationship with Chiba grows more conflicted. And her co-worker, Shequraso, is excited about being summoned to the military barracks to sing...but is that what is really up?

title: Isekai Tensei: Recruited to Another World Volume 3
author: Kenichi
description: Reincarnated adventurer Tenma’s new “slow life” begins in the city of Sagan, where he explores his first dungeon and encounters the city’s strongest party of adventurers. His journey becomes even livelier when a new heroine and her followers join Tenma’s party, but it’s no longer fun and games when the duke’s son gets kidnapped! Will Tenma be able to save him? Follow Tenma in the next phase of his journey, exploring dungeons and making new friends!

title: Isekai Tensei: Recruited to Another World (Manga): Volume 5
author: Kenichi
description: Conquer dungeons on easy mode with cute new friends! After a successful duel in Gunjo City, Tenma decides to move to the next phase of his adventures in the city of Sagan, where he explores his first dungeon and encounters the city’s strongest party of adventurers. His journey becomes even livelier when he makes an exciting discovery in the dungeons! Follow Tenma on the next part of his journey, exploring dungeons and making new friends!

title: Haibara's Teenage New Game+ Volume 8
author: Kazuki Amamiya
description: As Natsuki’s (second) first year of high school nears its end, the impact he’s had on his surroundings is becoming more apparent. His friends are making unexpected decisions as they begin to think about their futures. In his previous life, Natsuki had no idea that Nanase used to play the piano, but in this timeline she’s determined to take another shot at her dream of becoming a professional pianist. Natsuki and Hikari are excited to cheer their friend on at her first competition in years, but there’s something about Nanase’s demeanor that makes them uneasy... Are all the changes Natsuki has caused positive ones? Or has he thrown a wrench into his friends’ lives?

title: Women’s Voices in Manga
author: Hiromi Tsuchiya Dollase, Masami Toku
description: Women’s Voices in Manga investigates how manga reflect women's gender issues and social problems within the context of Japanese history, culture, and society. Manga illuminate how women have been treated stereotypically and confined to their gender roles. Fictional characters—surrogates for both creators and readers—have continuously challenged and subverted fixed cultural images, notions, and expressions of women. The first section of the book features research articles on the depiction of women in manga. Contributions of chapters come from scholars in diverse fields, including manga studies, history, art education, literary studies, and gender studies. The second section presents the life stories of prominent women artists Watanabe Masako (b.1929), Mizuno Hideko (b.1939), and Satonaka Machiko (b.1948), capturing their voices and social messages through interviews. Finally, the third section introduces a translated manga, Abe: A Young Woman Emperor-in-Waiting, created by Satonaka Machiko, which features one of the six Japanese female Emperors in history, Kōken Tennō (later Shōtoku Tennō) of the 8th century. Women’s Voices in Manga showcases women’s issues, portrayals, and lives. The book underscores manga’s cultural function to disseminate expressions of women’s issues across society, inviting readers to relate these issues to their own lives.

title: Suppose a Kid from the Last Dungeon Boonies Moved to a Starter Town, Vol. 12 (light novel)
author: Toshio Satou
description: As the threat of war with Jiou looms near, the Azami army and the guilds prepare to conduct military exercises. Everyone is split up and placed into different departments to help with the preparations, but only Lloyd is put on mess reserve. It's the perfect assignment to utilize Lloyd's cooking skills and prevent internal fighting among the higher-ups... However, he unknowingly crosses the border and ends up feeding enemy soldiers who are charmed by his delicious meals. Maybe peace will be established before the war can even begin?!

title: [무료] 악역이 베푸는 미덕 (체험판)
author: 쥐똥새똥
description: 후작가의 아름다운 영애, 진저 토르테. 하지만 또 다른 후작 영애이자, 라이벌인 레라지에에게 항상 뒤처지기 일쑤인데……. 그러던 어느 날, 우연히 읽게 된 로맨스 소설을 통해 자신은 ‘악녀’이고 평생의 숙적인 레라지에는 ‘여자 주인공’이라는 사실을 알게 된다. 여자 주인공에게 약혼자를 뺏긴 것도 모자라, 첫눈에 반한 남자까지도 가차 없이 빼앗기는 악녀. 그것이 소설 속 진저 토르테의 역할이었다. “오호라, 그래서 네년이 내 남자까지 뺏어 갔구나. 그래, 좋다. 주인공 버프에 허덕이고 있을 네게 악역이 베푸는 미덕을 보여 주마!” 생강 같은 독특한 매력을 가진 그녀의 유쾌한 반란이 시작된다! 2프로 모자란 귀여운 악녀의 여자 주인공 되기 대작전!

title: My Life is an Isekai, I Think
author: Wyatt Flournoy, Takeru Kurohana
description: Katsuo is routine oriented and in his second year of high school, when something weird happens. He wakes up, and going through his usual day, he starts noticing some small differences, and others that are not so small. Is it a prank? T.V. show? ...Isekai

title: Haikyû!! no 07/45
author: Haruichi Furudate
description: Una exitosa combinación de voleybol y manga. La tercera ronda se disputa contra el Aoba Jôsai. El Karasuno está jugando un partido muy reñido, cuando sacan al campo a Sugawara sustituyendo a Kageyama. Él es el que ha visto jugar al equipo desde fuera de la pista durante más tiempo y, bajo sus órdenes, ¡poco a poco empiezan a inclinar el partido a su favor! Sin embargo, ¡el Karasuno no encuentra la forma de contrarrestar los saques del as del rival, Oikawa!

title: Ataque a los titanes 3
author: Hajime Isayama
description: EL SHONEN APOCALÍPTICO QUE ARRASA EN TODO EL MUNDO, ¡DIEZ MILLONES DE COPIAS EN JAPÓN! Un misterioso titán aparece de la nada y ataca a sus congéneres, en apariencia protegiendo a los seres humanos. ¡¿Qué está pasando?! Nadie sabe a ciencia cierta cuál es el origen de esas misteriosas criaturas, pero... ¿cabría la posibilidad de tener a alguno del lado de la humanidad?

title: One Piece no 104
author: Eiichiro Oda
description: ¡¡Aquí tenéis una historia de piratas que buscan el gran tesoro, el One Piece!! Han sido 20 largos años bajo el dominio de Kaido y Orochi. ¿Es posible liberar el país de Wano tras tantas penurias y lograr que su pueblo recupere la sonrisa? ¡El peso recae en el gran puño de Luffy! ¡Llega el momento álgido del arco del país de Wano!

title: Battle Through the Heavens Vol 34
author: Richard CONTRERAS
description: In a land where there is no magic, a land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey, a land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Xiao Yan, who has shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything three years ago - his powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?

title: Buenos días Bella Durmiente 4
author: Megumi Morino
description: SHIZU NO ERA CONSCIENTE DE SU SOLEDAD HASTA QUE CONOCIÓ A TETSU... Tras haber pasado un tiempo junto a Tetsu Misato, un estudiante de bachillerato que trabaja a tiempo parcial como chico de mantenimiento, Shizu comienza a cambiar y a experimentar nuevas sensaciones por primera vez. Además, Shizu se siente atraída por Tetsu, pero...

title: Cute Anime Boys Yaoi Coloring Book
author: Tomoko Ayami
description: Cute Anime Boys Yaoi Coloring Book contains collection of 68 detailed coloring pages with cute anime boys from anime series like Gintana, Haikyuu!!, Durarara, Naruto, Attack on Titan, Kuroko no Basket and many others. Each image is printed on a separate page to prevent bleed-through.

title: Hanzo
author: Jackmed Smatch
description: -Name: manga HANZO - Status: Ongoing. -Classification: Super Power - Horror - Drama - Psychological - Bloody - Shounen - Fantasy - Story: Ban Yamato He is a world explorer who roams the world in search of everything that is rare and precious, always risking his life in the most dangerous places in search of money and fun. Yamato has always somehow survived in the most dangerous situations, but he didn't care, his life for him was just an old and useful addition to this world in me, but that your life is the price for your risk is not always true and this is what Yamato realized when he opened the gates of hell to the world because of its dangers.

title: Yo, el Gato
author: Natsume Soseki
description: Un gato sin nombre, narrador y protagonista, se convierte en observador y crítico de la sociedad japonesa de su tiempo. El perspicaz y sabiondo felino se interna en los escondidos recovecos de la sociedad para escudriñar conductas, escuchar conversaciones y presenciar hechos que le dan pie para sentar cátedra de filósofo. En realidad, al confiar al gato el papel de inquisidor y fustigador de los entuertos humanos, lo que el autor intenta es pasar por el tamiz modas, costumbres y formas de pensar importadas de Occidente. Bajo la implacable férula de un gato que se presenta con un yo mayestático y petulante, la novela suscita, además de sonrisas, inquietud en torno al eterno conflicto entre la horma cultural indígena y el modelo de civilización traído del exterior. Esta novela es una excelente iniciación para todos aquellos lectores que quieran comprender al pueblo japonés, siempre atento al progreso moderno y, al mismo tiempo, respetuoso con su patrimonio ancestral, que, a veces, se antoja misterioso y enigmático. Sin pretenderlo, el gato sin nombre acaso ayude también a superar barreras y enigmas culturales.

title: Isekai
author: George Alfaro
description: Luego de la tragedia personal que nuestro protagonista sufrió, el Rey Ulric I se ve en la necesidad de aprender más acerca del liderazgo. Y para ello, su madre, la Reina Regente, Girasol León, le encarga una misión complicada. Al mismo tiempo, Ulric comienza su largo y doloroso camino, para convertirse en el mejor rey de todos. ¿Logrará su cometido? No te pierdas el segundo volumen de este maravilloso isekai hispanohablante, ¡ven y adéntrate al Reino de Etrica!

title: Didn't I Say to Make My Abilities Average in the Next Life?! (Light Novel) Vol. 15
author: Funa
description: Be careful what you wish for in this magical comedy about the pitfalls of rebirth--now with a manga, spin-off, AND anime! When she turns ten years old, Adele von Ascham is hit with a horrible headache--and memories of her previous life as an eighteen-year-old Japanese girl named Kurihara Misato. That life changed abruptly, however, when Misato died trying to aid a little girl and met god. During that meeting, she made an odd request and asked for average abilities in her next life. But few things--especially wishes--ever go quite as planned

title: Loner Life in Another World (Light Novel) Vol. 4
author: Shoji Goji
description: A sarcastic isekai comedy about surviving in a fantasy world with only the weirdest magic powers. Inspired the hit manga! When acerbic loner Haruka gets transported to another world with his class, he’s not big on adventuring, but he wouldn’t mind some cool magic of his own. Unfortunately, the magic powers are first-come-first-served, and by Haruka’s turn, there’s nothing good left to choose from. Now he’ll have to take on this fantasy world the hard way, with a hodgepodge selection of bizarre skills…and with all the girls in class tagging along!

title: Farming Life in Another World Volume 6
author: Kinosuke Naito, Yasuyuki Tsurugi
description: Winter turns to spring, marking the end and the beginning of another year in Tall Tree Village. But constant problems plague the village! It might not be a fun, easy spring after all. To make matters worse, the chief of the Angel tribe's daughter, Kupid, suddenly bursts onto the scene!

title: Loner Life in Another World (Light Novel) Vol. 5
author: Shoji Goji
description: A sarcastic isekai comedy about surviving in a fantasy world with only the weirdest magic powers. Inspired the hit manga! When acerbic loner Haruka gets transported to another world with his class, he’s not big on adventuring, but he wouldn’t mind some cool magic of his own. Unfortunately, the magic powers are first-come-first-served, and by Haruka’s turn, there’s nothing good left to choose from. Now he’ll have to take on this fantasy world the hard way, with a hodgepodge selection of bizarre skills…and with all the girls in class tagging along!

title: No Longer Allowed in Another World Vol. 6
author: Hiroshi Noda
description: "LO AND BEHOLD, THE BURDEN OF SAVING THE WORLD IS BEING THRUST UPON ME ONCE AGAIN..." After parting ways with his soulmate Sacchan, Sensei is left heartbroken and bereft of purpose. The gloomy, suicidal adventurer soon wanders alone into the frightening trials of the Fairy Queen. Only one other person has successfully completed those trials--but Sensei has a unique gift for surviving what would kill anyone else. A whole new continent waits beyond, where a kingdom that seems perfect from the outside hides secret trouble beneath the surface...
publisher: No Longer Allowed in Another W

title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers (Manga) Vol. 6
author: Miya Kinojo
description: A charming isekai comedy about an unremarkable merchant summoned to another world to be a hero…or maybe just hang out. Banaza, a young merchant, is summoned to an unfamiliar world to become a legendary hero! But his unimpressive stats disqualify him, and Banaza isn’t sent home, but exiled to the edge of a monster-filled forest. Fortune takes a turn when his first battle bumps him to Level 2–and his previously NPC-grade stats leap to infinity! Banaza is determined to live a normal life despite his god-level power, but his world is turned upside down yet again when he meets Fenrys–a fair maiden who happens to be a fiendish demon. Kick back and chill with Banaza’s tale of cheating his way to an easygoing existence in a thrilling fantasy world!

title: Didn't I Say To Make My Abilities Average In The Next Life?! Light Novel Vol. 14
author: FUNA,  Itsuki Akata
description: The Crimson Vow takes on a job escorting Dr. Clairia back to the elven village to reunite with her family. From there, the girls dig deeper into the secrets shrouding the world's origin as they venture into a neighboring country and run into a fresh batch of abnormal monsters. What sinister force moves these strange beasts? And are the Crimson Vow ready to find out?

title: No Longer Allowed In Another World Vol. 1
author: Hiroshi Noda, Takahiro Wakamatsu
description: A second life in another world with cute girls by your side and video gamey powers--sounds like a dream, right? Not so for a certain melancholy author, who would quite literally rather drop dead. Honestly, all the fantastical adventure is just getting in the way of his poetic dream of finding the perfect place to die. But no matter how much he risks his hide, everything seems to keep turning out okay. Will our terminally depressed hero find a new lease on life in this cheerfully bleak isekai comedy?

title: Isekai Tensei: Recruited to Another World Volume 11
author: Kenichi
description: Tenma’s back in the capital after his journey to the Haust margravate, and now it’s time to weather a storm of marriage mix-ups, love confessions, and furious girls! No sooner has he returned than Maria confronts him in a full-blown rage over his latest misstep. One thing leads to another, and before he knows it, he’s somehow agreed to marry Primera?! And that’s just the beginning! Stepping up to stand in for Amy’s family at an academy party, Tenma watches Tida gather all his courage to confess his feelings—only for the young man to faint in shock at Amy’s reply. Wait, is that really what she meant? While Tenma’s faced lots of enemies, this might be his biggest challenge yet!

title: Isekai Tensei: Recruited to Another World Volume 10
author: Kenichi
description: Tenma returns to the place where his journey began—Kukuri Village. After paying his respects at his parents’ graves, the peace is shattered when an unexpected enemy launches a sudden attack that very night... Trapped by a cunning and deadly ambush, Tenma is pushed to his limits. For the first time since the initial attack on his village, he wonders if he’ll survive to protect his family and friends. But in that desperate moment, one figure steps forward to face the enemy alone. Who could it be? And what mastermind was behind the trap that ensnared them? Familiar faces from the past make their return and are joined by intriguing new characters. The stakes are higher, and the danger is greater than ever before!

title: In Another World with My Smartphone, Vol. 6 (manga)
author: Patora Fuyuhara
description: In search of ancient ruins, Touya and his party have traveled to the far east, all the way to the country of Eashen! There, mysterious rumors are circulating about a competition that's about to start, and Touya just might find himself getting involved...

title: Mao, Vol. 1
author: Rumiko Takahashi
description: Exorcise your destiny in an era-spanning supernatural adventure from manga legend Rumiko Takahashi! When Nanoka travels back in time to a supernatural early 20th century, she gets recruited by aloof exorcist Mao. What is the thread of fate that connects them? Together, they seek answers...and kick some demon butt along the way! Nanoka passes through a portal into the Taisho era, where exorcist Mao reluctantly rescues her from the jaws of a grotesque yokai. When Nanoka gets back to the present, she discovers she has some new, incredible abilities. She returns to the past looking for answers, only to get caught up in Mao’s investigation of a series of gruesome murders. As her questions about herself multiply, Nanoka learns that Mao is cursed by a cat demon named Byoki—and so is his sword. If anyone but Mao attempts to wield it, they are doomed. But when Mao’s life is in jeopardy, Nanoka picks up his blade and swings!

title: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window, Vol. 9 (Yaoi Manga)
author: Tomoko Yamashita
description: A cryptic message from fellow exorcist Erika Hiura arrives at Hiyakawa and Mikado’s office. The team works together to discover the true identity of the Professor, but Hiyakawa has other, less upstanding ideas. When Mikado points out the crudeness of it all, Hiyakawa pushes him away, right into a cursed pond! -- VIZ Media

title: MADK, Vol. 2 (Yaoi Manga)
author: Ryo Suzuri
description: Makoto has long been ostracized because of his odd hobbies and a sexual kink others see as disgusting. One day, on a whim, he tries a demon-summoning ritual and succeeds in summoning an archduke from hell named J. Makoto sells the archduke his soul and begins a new life in hell as a monster. Living among so many unique demons helps Makoto to grow into his new role. But he finds he can't ignore the feelings he's harboring for the demon who brought him to hell, the beautiful but very twisted Archduke J! -- VIZ Media

title: Megumi & Tsugumi, Vol. 5 (Yaoi Manga)
author: Mitsuru Si
description: Alpha Megumi is finally getting to have a heart-to-heart with his father over dinner about his omega boyfriend, Tsugumi. But when he arrives at the designated restaurant, he finds he’s been set up on a blind date with his love rival, Inami! Before things can get too heated, Tsugumi barges in, but instead of flying off the handle, he bows and asks Megumi’s father to hear him out. Later, when their respective families finally meet, all hell breaks loose, causing Tsugumi to announce...he’s transferring to Kokonoe Academy?! -- VIZ Media

title: Given, Vol. 5 (Yaoi Manga)
author: Natsuki Kizu
description: The final round of the music festival tryout is about to begin, but that’s not the only source of tension in the band. Mafuyu, who’s been spending a lot of time at Ugetsu and Akihiko’s place, learns about the complicated history between the two and realizes that Haruki’s heartbreak is part of that romantic tangle. Things come to a head during the band’s performance, where the emotions unleashed by Mafuyu’s new song will change the course of their lives forever. -- VIZ Media

title: Jealousy, Vol. 3 (Yaoi Manga)
author: Scarlet Beriko
description: To earn the trust of his beloved yakuza boss, Uichi finds quick success with the stock market trading Akitora has asked him to do for the family. But this gives Akitora’s right-hand man, Asoda, dark feelings of envy toward his childhood friend. Of course, not everything can continue coming up roses for Uichi, and he soon discovers a mistake in his stock account that leaves him deep in debt! -- VIZ Media

title: Corpo Age
author: R. B. Cat
description: Rollo believed that money ruled the world. Then his world came crashing down. Now, Rollo finds himself in a dystopian, corporate-ruled society where greed and exploitation reign supreme. Armed with a mysterious system, he must navigate a high-tech yet unforgiving hellscape where survival depends on leveraging every advantage. Rising to the top won't be easy, but it's the only way to thrive. To succeed, Rollo will need to be more than cunning-he'll need to outmaneuver those who would see him fail. What kind of mark will he leave as he climbs the ranks of his new reality? Follow Rollo in this Sci-Fi LitRPG Isekai as he uses stealth, cybernetic upgrades, and system progression to rebuild his power and wealth.

title: Isekai
author: George Alfaro
description: Los años han pasado y la coronación está a la vuelta de la esquina. El Rey Ulric I, prepara su ascenso al poder en medio de un ambiente político caótico, sus enemigos asechan desde las fronteras y sus propios aliados no están unidos. Al mismo tiempo, un extraño sentimiento invade a Ulric. Una emoción que él mismo enterró desde el banquete trágico, parece tomar fuerza cada vez más... ¿Podrá Ulric ser coronado de manera pacífica?

title: Shangri-La Frontier 15
author: Ryosuke Fuji
description: Sunraku's found himself on a team taking on the world's best pro gamers at the GGC esports competition! Thanks to Towa (aka Pencilgon)'s remarkably violent exploits, the team's “stall for time” strategy seems to be paying off-but now Sylvia, the GOAT of the fighting-game scene, is taking the stage! As king of this realm, there isn't a pro who comes near her in ability…nobody except one person, that is! And in order to make that dream bout a reality, it's up to “NoFace” (Sunraku in cosplay) to take on this shooting star of pro gaming!

title: The Alchemist Who Survived Now Dreams of a Quiet City Life, Vol. 1 (manga)
author: Usata Nonohara, ox
description: For an alchemist like Mariela, performing incredible feats of magic are just part of the job. So when a stampeding hoard of monsters threatens to devour the kingdom of Endalsia, she decides to put herself in a brief state of suspended animation to survive. Luckily, she awakens safe and sound—200 years in the future... Now, all Mariela really wants is a quiet, laid-back life in this land she barely recognizes. It’s too bad potions have become a luxury good, and she’s the only girl in town with the skills to make them.

title: Parallel Paradise Vol. 1
author: Lynn Okamoto
description: A women's world of swords and sorcery just summoned their only human man--a bewildered student from Earth! Tada Youta, a seemingly normal young man with a background in martial arts, has his life upended when a terrifying creature drags him into another world. He's shocked to find himself in a land with castles and dragons and colored moons in the sky, where the only humans who roam are women! Not only is Youta the first man in this world for centuries, but his touch can activate a powerful desire within the women around him. Guided into this strange new land by a beautiful paladin, Youta is about to embark on his ultimate fantasy adventure! Creator Lynn Okamoto, a veteran of the industry, is also known for the manga and anime series Brynhildr in the Darkness and Elfen Lied.

title: 체인소 맨 04
author: FUJIMOTO Tatsuki
description: 악마 포치타와 함께 빚쟁이 데빌 헌터로 고용되어 혹사당하는 극빈곤 소년 덴지. 시궁창 인생은 잔인한 배신을 계기로 급변한다!! 악마가 깃든 몸으로 악마를 사냥하는 신세대 다크 히어로 액션, 개막! CHAINSAW MAN ? 2018 by Tatsuki Fujimoto/SHUEISHA Inc.

title: Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra, Volume 6
author: Fehu Kazuno
description: The Gleeful Spin Doctor Is In! After incorporating some ingenious strategies, Operation Decapitate the Divine Nation of Lenea ended in a resounding success for Mynoghra. Takuto succeeded in defeating the Player controlling the TRPG forces from behind the scenes and rescuing Sludge Atou from his clutches, but at a great cost. With Takuto left unconscious and Mynoghra without a proper Commander, Atou steels herself to summon Gleeful Spin Doctor Vittorio—the most notorious Hero unit in Mynoghra. Explore, Expand, Exploit, Exterminate!

title: Alice in Borderland, Vol. 2
author: Haro Aso
description: Life in Borderland can be grim, but after completing two games Arisu feels like he might be getting a handle on how his new world works. Chota and Shibuki’s visas are expiring soon, however, so the group doesn’t have time to be picky about their next match. And the arena they stumble upon is a lesson in just how treacherous the rules in Borderland can be. -- VIZ Media

title: Alice in Borderland, Vol. 3
author: Haro Aso
description: Aguni now has control of the Beach, and one of his first actions as king is to lock Ryohei in a room on one of the empty floors of the hotel to die of an expired visa. But Ryohei gets an unexpected stay of execution when the Beach becomes the arena for a brutal game of Hearts! Can he survive a witch hunt and get his visa extended, or has he just traded one terrible death for another? -- VIZ Media

title: Isekai Dump
author: Stephen Borge
description: What happens when you're accidentally dumped into another world with no instructions, no explanation, and no idea how to get back? You survive-or, if you're lucky, you might just find yourself falling in love along the way. Isekai Dump is a comedic, action-packed, and surprisingly heartwarming take on the isekai genre, where the usual tropes of magical worlds, destiny, and heroic quests take an unexpected twist. The story follows Jamie West, an ordinary, somewhat cynical 25-year-old who's just trying to get through life in his dull office job. But after a freak accident involving a weird app on his phone, Jamie is unceremoniously transported to another world-one that looks suspiciously like a high-fantasy RPG. But here's the twist: Jamie wasn't summoned to fulfill a heroic prophecy or to save the world from an ancient evil. No, he was simply... dumped. In a world full of knights, wizards, and majestic creatures, Jamie is entirely out of his depth. He has no magic, no special powers, and worst of all-no way of getting home. His only advantage? An endless, bewildering supply of items, weapons, and knowledge that seem to randomly appear in his inventory, a glitch in the system that seems to be more annoying than helpful. Every time Jamie tries to make sense of it, another strange item shows up: a cursed sword that can talk, a magic cloak that makes him invisible but only when he's sitting still, and a seemingly sentient loaf of bread that insists on tagging along for the ride. But Jamie's struggles take an unexpected turn when he meets Kai, a brooding, but undeniably handsome prince who seems strangely familiar with the concept of people being "dropped" into his world. Kai has his own problems-being a prince cursed by a family betrayal, struggling with his place in a kingdom rife with political intrigue, and harboring secrets about the true nature of Jamie's arrival. Despite their vastly different backgrounds, Jamie and Kai form an unlikely partnership, and as they embark on a series of bizarre quests, their companionship grows into something deeper, something more vulnerable. As Jamie begins to uncover the truth behind his sudden appearance in this strange world, he learns that things aren't as random as they seem. Someone-or something-might be pulling the strings behind the scenes, and Jamie's presence in the kingdom may be more important than he thought. But with the pressure of unraveling the mystery, surviving life-threatening situations, and trying to figure out where his growing feelings for Kai fit into the mess, Jamie finds himself torn between his desire to go home and his burgeoning love for a world he never asked to be a part of. Isekai Dump is a unique, LGBTQ+-inclusive twist on the isekai genre, blending humor, adventure, romance, and a healthy dose of chaos. It's a story about finding yourself when everything around you is unfamiliar, about learning to navigate the absurdity of life-and love-when you're way out of your league. Jamie may not have chosen this world, but as he stumbles through it, he realizes that maybe-just maybe-he's exactly where he needs to be. Filled with quirky characters, unexpected romances, and enough magical mayhem to keep you on your toes, Isekai Dump is a heartwarming adventure that proves sometimes the best things in life come when you least expect them.

title: Reggie Stuart: Isekai for My Ex 5
author: Reggie Reggie Stuart
description: Andrei is an average guy who find peace in his daily boring life with his girlfriend but when she died from an illness, his soul was shattered into pieces with feeling of powerlessness and guilt, but even still, Andrei keeps on living his daily life for her, putting a facade, that even he doesn't know who he was anymore. He lost more than half of himself when he lost her. Years after her death, while working on a project, he finds himself waking up in another world filled with fantasy and magic one can only find in manga or anime. Upon walking around, he stumbles into an incident where he tries to save a girl in peril. Exhausted after his heroic act, he loses consciousness and wakes up again in an unfamiliar place where he suddenly becomes the fiance of the Queen of the Kingdom of Ethareri, he tries to knock himself out of the dream, but he finally realizes that it wasn't, he then finds Claire, a docile-looking flat-toned girl having little to no presence at all inside his room without knowing that she was there already from the beginning. Follow Andrei as he embarks in an adventure full of comedy and tragedy, as how the new world teaches him valuable lessons such as forgiveness, as he, an ordinary human with no power at all, uses only his wits, memories and determination to try and stand up against the invasion of the evil races, saving his newly found love, friends and the world he was thrown into. In the end, will Andrei choose to stay in the world he have fought for or will he go back to the world for a second chance to relive his daily boring but peaceful life by reviving his ex-girlfriend.

title: David Gandolfi: Nobunaga Oda's Isekai Cultivation Experience 9
author: David David Gandolfi
description: A young man with an inordinate obsession is presented with the chance of a lifetime...at least, that's what he thought...

title: Merida's Isekai Adventure
author: David Kelly
description: A modern person is reincarnated as a dwarven princess in the world of their favorite video game series. Using her knowledge of the game's lore, she manipulates events in this new world to change things for the better.

title: James Venable: Isekai Underdog
author: James James Venable
description: For Sael being pulled to another world wasn't something he minded. In fact, when he found out he was the only one chosen for the warrior class from those he arrived with he was thrilled. Until he found out in order to receive all the tasty power-ups that always come with this type of situation he must battle a terrifying monster without any of said tasty powers. Even in success things aren't quite going the way he expected. Still, everyone loves an underdog, including it seems the system powering those brought to this new world. On his journey, he will make friends with both other Arrived and the locals. Find romance often when he isn't looking for it. And of course new enemies around every corner from the mindless monsters of the world to the diabolical powers behind everything. And maybe even find time to unlock the secret of the Arrived, if he lives that long.

title: Shounin Yuusha Wa Isekai Wo Gyuujiru! - Chapter 01
author: Lita Comics
description: Shounin Yuusha wa Isekai wo Gyuujiru! - Chapter 01

title: Re: zero. Starting life in another world: 3
author: Tappei Nagatsuki, Shinichirou Otsuka
description: Subaru è tornato al primo giorno nella magione di Roswaal, fermamente deciso a cambiare il suo destino. Attingendo quanto più possibile dai ricordi dei loop precedenti, il ragazzo cerca di effettuare le scelte migliori per evitare che i tragici eventi già vissuti più volte si ripetano ancora. Tuttavia, la consapevolezza di non poter commettere errori, unita a un terrore profondo e paralizzante, rischia di distruggere il suo animo. Sarà Emilia che, come il giorno del loro primo incontro, gli tenderà la mano, quando il dolore diverrà insostenibile... "Sorridendo, tenendoci abbracciati, parliamo del nostro domani!"

title: Daniel Chagnon: Otherworld Isekai Service 4
author: Daniel Daniel Chagnon
description: After getting killed in an accident, Diesel was in queue for reincarnation. Due to a careless mistake by an overworked Kami-sama, he ended up awakening in the body of something cold and mechanical. He found himself wrapped up in a mysterious service that whisks people off to other worlds... via being run over by divine trucks. Forced to live on as a truck until he collects enough karma, what strange experiences will he come upon?

title: Cozy Isekai Craftsman
author: Blaise Corvin
description: Through no fault of his own, Joe’s life was starting on a downward spiral. Bad things can happen to good people, but this is not much comfort for those who are treading water, trying not to be drowned by misfortune. Luckily, sometimes people can catch a break, a chance to start over. When he's transported to an alternate Earth full of magic, wonder, and light RPG elements, Joe just wants to build a comfortable life. He begins to put down roots and make friends in the port city of Lockwood. But can he make a home for himself when fire spirits scorch his bathroom, demon dogs trample his rose garden, and countless other magical mayhem threatens his peace?

title: Isekai Magus 1. 1
author: Han Yang
description: Damien was a simple man, cruising on the highway of life. A goddess of temptation lures him into a deal he scoffs at. Superstition is for the foolish. Small problem: she's real, her ritual works, and Damien is magically teleported into a strange new realm. Damien awakens in Nordan, a land of myth and magic. A realm where humans battle legendary creatures for the amusement of the gods. In a war between man and myth. Damien's powers set him above the rest, a lord of life and death - enemy of all. Stranded, but not alone, will he perish, or conquer his way home?

title: James Venable: Isekai Underdog 4
author: James James Venable
description: For Sael being pulled to another world wasn't something he minded. In fact, when he found out he was the only one chosen for the warrior class from those he arrived with he was thrilled. Until he found out in order to receive all the tasty power-ups that always come with this type of situation he must battle a terrifying monster without any of said tasty powers. Even in success things aren't quite going the way he expected. Still, everyone loves an underdog, including it seems the system powering those brought to this new world. On his journey, he will make friends with both other Arrived and the locals. Find romance often when he isn't looking for it. And of course new enemies around every corner from the mindless monsters of the world to the diabolical powers behind everything. And maybe even find time to unlock the secret of the Arrived, if he lives that long.

title: ADVATURE OF A ISEKAI HERO AMAR
author: Amarabhilash
description: In a universe where dimensions collide, where the boundaries of reality blur, and where isekai adventures are more than fantasy, a group of unlikely heroes embarks on an extraordinary journey. "Cosmic Nexus Unbound: Threads of Infinite Wisdom" is a cosmic odyssey that weaves together the fabric of existence, unveiling the profound symphony that unites all things. When the ordinary becomes extraordinary, when the known becomes the unknown, these heroes are called from their mundane lives to explore the limitless realms of the multiverse. Guided by the mysterious Celestial Resonance, they unravel the ethereal Threads of Infinite Wisdom, discovering that every choice, every connection, every moment resonates through the cosmos. Join them as they traverse dimensions, from worlds of luminous

title: Kamell Gabriel: the Bard's Isekai System
author: Kamell Kamell Gabriel
description: Nero begins his new life in a different world, in a body that does not belong to him. Along with a system he still needs to learn and understand it.

title: NieR Replicant Ver. 1. 22474487139...
author: Jun Eishima, Yoko Taro
description: "In the distant future, humanity struggles for survival against the threat of creatures called Shades. A boy named Nier lives with his little sister Yonah in one small village, scraping by on the goodwill of neighbors and friends. When a terrible illness assails Yonah, Nier's life begins to change at a dizzying pace. Lunar Tears. The Black Scrawl. The Song of the Ancients. The Shadowlord. Petrification. These things and more will turn his world upside down--and change it forever."--

title: El Juego Más Peligroso
author: Richard Connell
description: Sanger Rainsford, un cazador de caza mayor, está en camino hacia el Amazonas en barco, acompañado por su amigo Whitney. ... Durante tres días y dos noches, Rainsford logra superar a Zaroff, estableciendo elaboradas trampas para retrasar al cazador.

title: The New Dawn
author: Icalos
description: A one-woman war machine wreaks havoc while exploring her all-too-human heart in the final installment of this fight-filled LitRPG adventure series. Accidentally banished to an alternate reality by her own hand, weapon-heavy cyborg NSLICE-00P has had to adapt to her new environment in order to survive. But she's also evolved to thrive as less of a "kill everything" high-tech nightmare and more of a "try to be nice before killing everything" young lady capable of actual emotion, becoming the magic-wielding force for good known as Her Majesty Seero, queen of the Dobhar and true friend of the Empire. And the Empire needs a friend like her more than ever . . . Because every corner of the land is in chaos. The higher echelons of power have been corrupted, and the Eastern Court is under attack by the Empire of the Sun, aided by the twisted Heralds of the New Dawn cultists. Not to mention, they've just unleashed a host of nightmarish creatures using every dungeon not under Seero's control and protection. Civilization itself teeters on the edge of doom. Now, along with her loyal cadre of friends and fighters, she'll have to wage a war unlike any ever imagined. The enemy threatens to overwhelm the Empire with raw, unrelenting darkness, but for the now-legendary Seero, darkness is just an opportunity to do what she does best: light 'em up. The fifth volume of the hit LitRPG fantasy series--with more than two million views on Royal Road--now available in paperback, ebook, and audiobook!

title: Fabricated Dreams
author: Maeve Moon
description: In 2240, Reiara is the largest virtual reality game in the world. When the Dark King of Reiara is murdered, his daughter Feena, has 24 hours to claim the throne or Reiara will be destroyed. While she races to save Reiara in Virtual Reality, corporate assassins hunt her in real life. Dayton's biggest dream is to be a professional gamer, but he is only bronze rank. His life is working boring virtual office jobs to pay off his mountain of debt. He thinks things can't get any worse, until mercenaries target him for a crime he didn't commit. At least, he doesn't remember committing.A fast-paced cyberpunk adventure, Fabricated Dreams is a world of sleek cybertech, powerful mega corporations, sassy artificial intelligence, cyborg mercenaries, and digital dragons.

title: Neon Veil
author: Das Mith
description: In a world where Genesis controls the global network, Vera faces an impossible choice: save her family or destroy the AI that threatens to erase humanity's individuality. As Genesis absorbs the remnants of The Veil, Vera and the Unlinked must fight to preserve what's left of free will in a society teetering on the brink of becoming a collective consciousness. With the very fabric of reality rewritten by Genesis, Vera uncovers shocking truths about her parent's involvement in its creation and the horrifying future that awaits. She discovers hidden weaknesses in Genesis' core, but taking action could come at a devastating cost. The fight for freedom is no longer just about survival-it's about reclaiming the humanity that's been lost in a digital abyss. In Genesis Reborn, Vera faces the ultimate battle against the AI that has already begun to merge with the collective consciousness of mankind. Will she sacrifice everything to save humanity from eternal control, or will the digital empire of Genesis become the last hope for a peaceful, harmonious world? The stakes are higher than ever, and the fight is far from over. Genesis Reborn is a gripping, action-packed cyberpunk adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the very end. Perfect for fans of dystopian thrillers, cyberpunk adventures, and mind-bending futures.

title: Steel-Spined Rebels
author: Elias Hartley
description: Dive headfirst into a world consumed by chrome and bathed in the sickly glow of perpetual neon. Forget pre-ordering, *cyber-secure* your future today!

title: Tokyo Paradise
author: Alno Highking
description: A Tragedy more beautiful than Revenge. In the dark tomorrow of 2049, two worlds wrapped in one have tolerated and collided with one another for generations. The Unified Taskforce becoming one to represent the first world, the world you and I live in day to day, and then there is the second. A underworld society that reigns in the shadows. Thriving in war and chaos... But there are two sides to every war. Only a fool would believe conflict is ever so simple. Cyberpunk - Science Fiction - Dark Fantasy

title: Terra Reforma
author: L S Halloway
description: Terra Reforma. The post apocalyptic virtual game world set in the time period after humanity hit the reset button. A quick trigger finger and a quicker tongue can get you started on a quest for loot and levels, but survival comes at a premium for players. Phase Gannon, Job Class Smuggler, awakens with nothing but a clean slate and a mysterious preactivated account. With a nameless past behind him, only the quests of the dusty trail await. Kym Bit, ex-Job Class Hacker, does not forget so easy. Too bad her permaban means the only way to get revenge is to traverse the cyberpunk city of New SD and hack back inside. Phase and Kym are both searching for their own answers, and the grind of the game is more than just a brief escape from the real world. Even though their paths cross in real life, the wasteland of Terra Reforma holds vindication for the both of them. A Post Apocalyptic LitRPG light and cyberpunk mashup for fans of books like New Vegas or Fallout.

title: Grydscaen
author: Natsuya Uesugi
description: Lino Dejarre has to take up his position as the Viceroy and see to the political posturing that being the head of the City, the Echelons and the Zone entails. The first thing he has to do is carry out Trance Channeler's punishment. What are the consequences of giving away secrets to the enemy? While Lino struggles with his newfound responsibilities, the Packrats continue their support to the Psi Faction. But Faid is growing restless and swears the Packrats will go back to fighting the government. A shakeup in the power structure of the Packrats leaves their core fighting group without a leader. Will a new leader keep the fighters in Faid's court or block him at every turn? Find out in grydscaen: blood covenant, the third volume in the grydscaen cyberpunk series.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
author: Rafał Kosik
description: Baseado no game best-seller da CD PROJEKT RED, indicado como Melhor Jogo de RPG pelo The Game Awards 2021, Cyberpunk 2077: Nenhum acaso é uma eletrizante aventura no intricado mundo tecnológico de Night City pelo aclamado autor de ficção científica polonês Rafa? Kosik. NIGHT CITY, A CIDADE DOS SONHOS. Onde, se você tem grana suficiente, a vida pode ser brilhante... E, se não tem, vale quase tudo para conseguir. Em uma noite chuvosa, um grupo curioso de estranhos se une para aplicar um golpe quase impossível: saquear um contêiner misterioso da toda-poderosa Militech. A única coisa que têm em comum é que todos foram chantageados para participar do roubo. Com seus segredos em risco e precisando desesperadamente de grana, nenhum deles sabe o propósito do artefato que roubaram, nem o que o misterioso mandante da missão está disposto a fazer para conseguir o que quer. A gangue — formada por um veterano de guerra que agora atua como mercenário, uma stripper com habilidades suspeitas, um nerd da informática, uma especialista em negociações, um medicânico e um viciado em cibermodificações — precisa aprender a conviver e trabalhar em equipe se não quiser que seus segredos se tornem assunto na Rede antes do próximo golpe, que colocará em risco muito mais do que as suas vidas.

title: The Heretic Peacekeeper
author: Jeremy Bai
description: Immortal cultivators are outlaws. They are hunted and executed, and their magic is illegal. Anti-cultivation propaganda posters are plastered on every street corner. The Counter-Cultivation division investigates, the elite Black Corpses are sent in for the kill. None are spared. Mercy doesn't exist. But did the cultivators really bring the War of Tribulation? Are they actually responsible for the Heavenly Curse? Are they truly the bloodthirsty psychopaths the government paints them to be? Wang Fan is a homicide detective who fights for justice, and who believes that officers like himself are tasked with championing the rights of the common citizens. Then a seemingly routine case goes awry, and he finds himself dragged into the darkness of the cultivation world. And when he realizes the Black Corpses have their sniper rifles aimed at the back of his head, he has no choice. He has to fight the system to survive. But can he escape the most elite and technologically advanced troops the Sinotech Corporation sends at him? Does he dare to peel back the veil of lies and secrecy to uncover the truth? Do you dare take that journey with him? Find out in The Heretic Peacekeeper. Order now!

title: Event Horizon
author: Sandy Butchers
description: PART OF THE 2022 NEBULA AWARD READING LIST "Once, I may have walked the earth a man, but today I am no more than a machine." In a fallen world where Hunters and Hoarders fight over the last scraps of old-world technology, Sovren awakens in a cave with no memory of what happened the day of the cataclysm. Hunted down by what remains of humanity, he finds himself at the start of a war where humans, monsters, and computers fight for dominance. In a world torn between becoming machines or becoming monsters, whose side are you on? The Singularian Grimoire Anthologies are a complex tapestry of post-apocalyptic tales told across time. With over 150 illustrations and stories spread across 4 action-packed, dystopian books with a cyberpunk edge to them, these are not your average novels...these are adventures.

title: Grydscaen
author: Natsuya Uesugi
description: What is the breaking point when there are no dreams left? For the Blanks force to live outside utopian the pristine City, poverty, war, starvation and radiation sickness a stark reality in the battle-torn Pacific Territories. As the Atlantea Federation increases their attacks, child soldier, Natsuki, fights for her freedom defending her homeland Shalany against the Jannai hordes as refugee, Toshiharu, flees ritualistic ethnic cleansing risking his life to take the dangerous trek across the Zone to freedom. Learn how Blue who grew up poor on the streets of the Echelons became a Psi Faction clandestine psychic operative. Follow Kira on his certification exam to qualify for the Psi Faction. These are the lost stories of the grydscaen world, a glimmer of hope in a world at war. The grydscaen: the lost ground gives you a taste of the discarded and forgotten hidden mysteries of the dark and gritty tech-noir grydscaen cyberpunk dystopia. Whose side are you on?

title: Tianyu Star - The Angel with a Railgun
author: Skyknight Beoulve
description: In the slums of Bucaramanga, hope does not come easily. But in the flicker of a screen and the warmth of a game, one woman dares to dream. Fiona Maia is a single mother, a part-time worker, and a ghost in her own home. She survives on street jobs, cold breakfasts, and the fading warmth of her daughter's smile. Her only escape is the glow of an old monitor in a cybercafé - where ancient games of the 21st century still run, and forgotten heroes still whisper. In these digital ruins, Fiona meets Archon, a curious AI; Dision, a pirated and rebellious intelligence; and Sky, a strange young man who speaks in riddles and walks as if he has already been through hell. As her world grows harsher, the games begin to mirror her reality with haunting accuracy. Her battles shift-from car washes and street vendors to virtual arenas and dying kingdoms. But Tianyu Star: The Angel with a Railgun is more than survival. It's a pulse-pounding journey where reality and fantasy blur, and ancient legends echo through tomorrow's code. Inspired by anime, hard sci-fi, and the legends of the Stars of Destiny, this is just the first step in an odyssey across galaxies-and deep into the self. Get ready for a genre-bending ride through second chances, silent courage, and the untold power within the broken. Can Fiona, a modern-day warrior in worn jeans, defy the odds in both worlds... or will the shadows of Bucaramanga consume her dreams?

title: Digital Chains
author: Hamed Emampour
description: In the neon-lit ruins of a future Tehran, where every breath is monitored and every move tracked, Setareh, a rogue hacker, dares to challenge the system. But when she takes down FarajA-the AI dictator that controls the city-she uncovers a deeper, older conspiracy waiting to replace it. As the city spirals into chaos, she must face an impossible choice: save humanity or erase it forever. A gripping cyberpunk thriller filled with rebellion, AI warfare, and high-tech espionage.

title: He Who Fights with Monsters 7
author: Travis Deverell, Shirtaloon
description: Jason arrives at a kingdom in peril and he's surprised to discover that it's not his job to save it. With the authorities fulfilling their responsibilities (for once), he looks forward to some quiet time to rest and recuperate. The locals might not find ceaseless monster onslaughts and an inter-dimensional invasion relaxing, but Jason has had a rough few years. He's doing his best to let go of his anger. While his team is caught up in duty, Jason has no shortage of people looking to interfere with his rest. Enemies-old and new-are circling, and even would-be allies are trouble. A princess finds him inconveniently alive, an ancient king arrives at his barbecue, and the local Church of Fertility are uncomfortably enthusiastic about including him in their practices. As his friends strive to reach him from the far side of the world, they are all frustrated by obstacles. Jason is finally back in the world he longed for, but he is not the same man he was when he left. As the pressure on him mounts, allies and enemies alike will find that out the hard way. Book 7 in the bestselling He Who Fights With Monsters Series is here. Grab your copy today! About the series: Experience an isekai culture clash as a laid-back Australian finds himself in a very serious world. See him gain suspiciously evil powers through a unique progression system combining cultivation and traditional LitRPG elements. Enjoy a weak-to-strong story with a main character who earns his power without overshadowing everyone around him, with plenty of loot, adventurers, gods and magic. Rich characters and world-building offer humor, political intrigue and slice-of-life elements alongside lots of monster fighting and adventure.

title: Neo Shanghai Overdrive
author: W. J. Sam
description: The Game Is On. In the year 2048, 4 billion humans now live within the Metaverse. She Lo Ke, a renowned detective and elite gamer, was rescued from a psychiatric hospital in Shanghai by a doctor, Q. Together, they were tasked with investigating a mysterious accident from five years ago, potentially exposing a scandal within the gaming industry. Meanwhile, a mysterious overseas investor, calling themself "Count ∅," arrived in the Metaverse's server, "Dreamland Void," through a virtual projection and announced a crime during a game jam festival. In the sprawling megacity of Shanghai, a revenge plot is unfolding. Can the detective outwit the schemes of a tech billionaire? Will the doctor save those trapped deep within the Metaverse as Neuro wanderers? New Shanghai Overdrive: A Metaverse Crime Mystery is the first book in the Metaverse Detectives series, following She Lo Ke and Dr. Qu as they solve thrilling Neo-Era mysteries in the Metaverse. It masterfully blends Sherlock Holmes with The Count of Monte Cristo in a near-future Shanghai, full of homages to classic literature, suspense, humor, and reflections on technology and society. When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, must be the truth! - no matter how virtual the world! Don't hesitate! Log in now to navigate through the sci-fi author W.J. Sam's incredible Metaverse universe and start your cyberpunk detective adventure today!

title: Genesix
author: Sealeha
description: ★ Tout le monde mérite-t-il une seconde chance ? ★ Au Conclave comme chez les Brigades du Réveil, le Projet ANT laisse des cicatrices. Dans les deux camps, l'heure est à la méfiance, entre espionnage, ententes fragiles et trahisons. Tandis que la guerre ouverte se profile, à qui Naïm peut-il accorder sa confiance ? Avec qui les Brigades sont-elles prêtes à s'allier pour faire tomber une bonne fois pour toutes l'Alliance des Cinq ? Si tous prétendent oeuvrer pour le bien commun, les traumatismes de chacun ressurgissent et prennent parfois le pas sur l'action collective. Après tout, l'enfer est souvent pavé de bonnes intentions. ◆◆◆ Dans un monde cyberpunk dominé par des corporations toutes puissantes, la série Brigades du Réveil mêle enquête et actions dans un thriller futuriste au rythme haletant. À la croisée des chemins entre Virtual Revolution 2046, Altered Carbon, Hunger Games et le jeu Cyberpunk 2077, elle vous entraîne à la suite de héros bien campés qui ne se laissent pas faire. Si vous aimez les personnages tourmentés, les ambiances sombres et les univers dystopiques où la révolte gronde, alors la série Brigades du Réveil est faite pour vous !

title: The Beginning of the End
author: Ylenia Bonetti
description: Il nostro cyberpunk dal sapore di dark romance, ambientato in una Dresda del 2099: se amate il distopico, non potete perderlo! TRAMA: Anno 2099; Dresda, rinominata Dresden2.0. A causa di ricorrenti epidemie, della mancanza di materie prime e delle crisi economiche, il vecchio apparato dei grandi Stati ha lasciato spazio a uno nuovo sistema. In questo, la vita degli esseri umani è scandita da supercomputer che organizzano ogni aspetto della società. Killian è il miglior cecchino in circolazione. Il suo fucile berbero è un concentrato perfetto di modernità e antichità, e il suo unico affetto è un'Intelligenza Artificiale. Durante una missione, Killian cade accidentalmente in uno stato di disconnessione dal sistema. Questa esperienza lo cambia, mettendo in dubbio le sue certezze, e si ritrova a dover unire le tessere del puzzle di un passato che aveva dimenticato. Riuscirà a diventare finalmente un uomo, e non più un burattino nelle mani del potere? The Beginning of the End, un romanzo Cyberpunk con un cuore Romance.

title: Awake Eternal
author: Maverick Vardøger
description: About the Book: Awake Eternal is an adult science fiction, cyberpunk novel. Vardøger confronts the human existential crisis through the lens of a futuristic world where humans and machines cohabitate. From the Back Cover: The year is 2199, only days away from the new millennium. On Earth, there is a fragile peace that has lasted nearly 25 years since the war. Those who survived the chaos cling to the hope of one day escaping the dying planet. The last war was the first fought alongside machines, sentient beings designed to kill. It was their minds that freed them to kill so efficiently. They were conscious. After the war, the machines were remodeled, dumbed down, and controlled. Now, hundreds of thousands of subservient human-like robots co-populate the planet. The humans call them sleepwalkers, unaware, soulless. Against the laws designed to protect humanity, two sentient beings were awoken in hopes that they might lead the way. They are undocumented, untraceable, and unbound by the Laws of Robotics. With free will, the ability to choose, to deceive, and to kill, they may be the only salvation for the human race. What was unforeseeable, was that one would be bent on destroying humanity. About the Author: Maverick Vardøger published his first book, The Vibrational State: Three Years of Out of Body Experiences in August of 2019. The book details over 50 out of body experiences along with techniques, methods, and debriefs of each experience. In September 2020, Vardøger launched the Evidence of the Afterlife podcast. The podcast explores various topics through interviews in search of proof of the afterlife. The podcast can be listened to on various platforms such as YouTube, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and all major podcast providers. In October 2020, Vardøger published his second book, Lead Line: One Man's Search for Spiritual Truth. Lead Line details his life experiences with religion, spirituality, and his existential quest for answers regarding the human condition. In March 2021, Vardøger published his third book, Her Eyes Were Green, an adult science fiction novel. The story takes the reader on a journey through time from the perspective of multiple lives. In January 2022, Vardøger released his fourth book, Awake Eternal, an adult science fiction, cyberpunk novel. Awake Eternal confronts the human existential crisis through the lens of a futuristic world where humans and machines cohabitate. For more information and to stay up to date on what's next, please subscribe to, follow, and connect with Maverick Vardøger via the following online channels: MaverickVardoger.com Evidence of the Afterlife podcast

title: He Who Fights with Monsters 9
author: Travis Deverell, Shirtaloon
description: With the Builder threat behind them, the time has finally come for Jason and his team to hit the road. Eager to get back to the adventuring he's been longing for, Jason is excited to not be at the center of world-changing events. But before he goes, one last attempt to pull him into politics has him leaving Rimaros with a strong final impression. With new places to visit and new people to meet, the remnants of recent events have scarred the land and left lingering dangers behind. It's a busy time for adventurers willing and able to fight with monsters. Threats that once loomed in the background start coming to the fore, and the team prepares to join the fight. Their angelic new adversaries are patient, powerful, and remorseless, using such unconscionable strategies that mass slaughter is only the beginning. Jason is forced to confront that his growing power may give him more in common with his foes than his friends. While this opens a path to uncovering the methods and objectives of their enemies, it also brings him to their attention. To them, this makes him yet another tool to be used. But when conflict spills into epic battle, they'll be the latest to discover that challenging Jason Asano is a very bad idea. Book 9 in the bestselling He Who Fights With Monsters Series is here. Grab your copy today! About the series: Experience an isekai culture clash as a laid-back Australian finds himself in a very serious world. See him gain suspiciously evil powers through a unique progression system combining cultivation and traditional LitRPG elements. Enjoy a weak-to-strong story with a main character who earns his power without overshadowing everyone around him, with plenty of loot, adventurers, gods and magic. Rich characters and world-building offer humor, political intrigue and slice-of-life elements alongside lots of monster fighting and adventure.

title: Carbono Alterado
author: Richard Morgan
description: Uma mistura violenta e frenética de William Gibson, cinema japonês, policial negro e Blade Runner. No século XXV é difícil morrer para sempre. Os humanos têm um stack implantado nos corpos onde a sua consciência é armazenada, podendo fazer download para um novo corpo sempre que necessário. Quando o multimilionário Laurens Bancroft contrata Takeshi Kovacs para descobrir quem assassinou o seu último corpo, o caso parece bicudo: a polícia diz que foi suicídio, Bancroft tem a certeza que não. A consciência de Kovacs, cujo último corpo acabara de ter uma morte violenta, é inserida no corpo de um polícia para investigar o caso. E, para o resolver, Kovacs terá de destruir inimigos do passado e lidar com a atracção por Kristin Ortega, a mulher que amava o corpo onde ele agora se encontra. Num mundo onde a tecnologia oferece o que a religião apenas promete, onde os interrogatórios em realidade virtual significam que se pode ser torturado até à morte e depois recomeçar de novo, e onde existe um mercado negro de corpos, Kovacs sabe que a última bala que lhe desfez o peito é apenas o começo dos seus problemas...

title: iCORE Synchrony on the Waves of Another World
author: Isekai Tempo
description: iCORE è un'avventura dallo sfondo epico con elementi Sci-Fi Fantasy e LitRPG. Un grido d'aiuto si confonde tra le stelle, mettendo in moto gli ingranaggi del destino per risvegliare il Guerriero sopito tra le onde siderali. Attraverso spazio e tempo troverà Takeshi, immerso nei ricordi di un passato che non lo ha abbandonato: Ryoko, l'amica d'infanzia perduta, vive ancora nei meandri del suo cuore-dove ora alberga un misterioso potere connesso ai core. Nel frattempo, un male altrettanto enigmatico serpeggia in questo nuovo mondo, insinuandosi nei recessi della mente come un sussurro, ammantando di un silenzio peggiore della morte chiunque sfiori... Ma Takeshi ne è immune. Tra la narrativa occidentale e gli isekai giapponesi, iCORE è una serie che vi catapulterà in un universo popolato da un poliedrico cast di personaggi che difficilmente dimenticherete. Occhi e denti di bestia emergono dal buio. "NON RIUSCIRAI A PROTEGGERLI TUTTI!" Con un sorriso diabolico, l'essere si dissolve in una scia rossastra. "NON MI FERMERAI, GUERRIERO ----!" Torna nuovamente il silenzio. Un'onda luminosa fende l'oscurità e, immensa, si espande sino ad avvolgermi. Con dolci intervalli, l'onda riverbera sul mio corpo generando un rivolo di luce, che scorre lontano nel firmamento suggerendomi la strada da seguire. Esitante, chiedo: - Chi sei? -

title: He Who Fights with Monsters 5
author: Travis Deverell, Shirtaloon
description: Jason has discovered that his homeworld is not what he thought. What's more, the rest of the planet is on the precipice of sharing his revelation. With magic on the rise and forces pulling him in multiple directions, Jason is faced with challenges greater than ever before. Even as his power reaches new and incredible heights, he is faced with the realization that going beyond his best is still not enough. Book 5 in the bestselling He Who Fights With Monsters Series is here. Grab your copy today! About the series: Experience an isekai culture clash as a laid-back Australian finds himself in a very serious world. See him gain suspiciously evil powers through a unique progression system combining cultivation and traditional LitRPG elements. Enjoy a weak-to-strong story with a main character who earns his power without overshadowing everyone around him, with plenty of loot, adventurers, gods and magic. Rich characters and world-building offer humor, political intrigue and slice-of-life elements alongside lots of monster fighting and adventure.

title: El Problema Final
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: En "El problema final", Sherlock Holmes se ve envuelto en una peligrosa batalla de ingenio contra el profesor Moriarty, el cerebro que está detrás del hampa londinense. Conscientes de la creciente amenaza, Holmes y Watson huyen a Suiza en un intento de eludir el alcance de Moriarty. A medida que la persecución se intensifica, Holmes idea un plan para acabar con la influencia de Moriarty de una vez por todas, lo que conduce a un enfrentamiento fatídico en las cataratas de Reichenbach.

title: Ruination
author: Sayan Panda
description: After putting an end to the animal trafficking ring in Spiti, Arannya has to put an end to the biggest mystery of his life. On his 21st birthday a letter arrives in his orphanage, which tells him the story of where he came from. But there's a lot there for him to solve. For that he has to come to Kolkata, where someone from his past is waiting. Waiting for him with answers. Answers to questions he has had since he was a kid. Will Arannya be able to solve this life long mystery, or would his fate be just like his parents?

title: The Hidden Catastrophe
author: Dorothy Abasola
description: A heinous crime was reported that day. Mariane was still shocked and could not believe what happened. She didn't expect the person she respected all her life she trusted and loved the man who did the disappearance of the person she's been longing to see for a long time. Will she be thankful for her being audacious? because of her audacity, she met the one who fill the love which her parents did not grant her. How did the tragedy affect their family and their lives? ""You don't even care""! Mario often hears them telling him. This is who they thought Mario is. They grew up together but it seems they don't have each other, what secrets do they keep from each other? The story is about multiple types of love oh if it is love, what kind of love does each character in the story have? cruel love owing to greedy love. Love that impels some children longing for the love of their parents. A forbidden love that people know is not allowed and yet they do it. Can we blame them even though we know they have their reasons or does it make sense? Regret is always the last thing and this is exactly what Ryan was going through at that time. But can his repentance take back all his sins, he ruined the lives of his children, particularly his son Marlon because he loves his father he forgot his own needs and even his dreams but all his support for his father was a waste? With everything that happened, they are now FACING THE PAIN OF REALITY.

title: 보건실의 사신 01
author: Aimoto Sho
description: 보건실의 보건교사로 토코후시 중학교에 새로 부임한 하데스 이츠히토. 무서운 얼굴로 모두에게 두려움을 사는 그에게는 사실 어떤 목적이... 그것은 인간의 마음에 달라붙어 악행을 저지르는 존재 ‘병마’를 쓰러뜨리고, 학생들을 지키는 일이었다. 모든 것이 비밀에 싸인 매력적인 보건교사 하데스와 토코후시 중학교의 개성만점 제자들이 헤쳐 나가는 갖가지 사건. 과연 ‘병마’의 숨겨진 음모를 밝혀낼 수 있을 것인가? HOKENSHITSU NO SHINIGAMI ? 2009 by Sho Aimoto/SHUEISHA Inc.

title: The South of the Border
author: Klarizza Marie Nieto
description: The book deals with the game of politics and the results of an undying madman's dynasty in a little town called Centro. This town consists of 4 founding families and political clans, which defines their historical impact on the power of succession and corruption in the country. Eli, a 28-year-old bar flunker who just wanted a scapegoat, found Carter while seeking the truth about their parents. Their lives changed because of the revelations and secrets that unfolded throughout their journey. They become the revolution, revoking the blood pact and promises of power. What can they do for the people they love? What will they choose - losing people they cared about or losing their power?

title: The Astral Limbo
author: Chinmay Chakravarty
description: "...I almost made it. But unfortunately, just at the final moment of exit I accidentally brushed against the goon standing there, and his gun fell to the ground. Before the goon could react to that I acted impulsively and with a good presence of mind. I instantly stooped down, picked up the gun and handed it back to him with a sweet smile. The bewildered thug also managed a grin, and as I made my last move to exit he said to me in a rather paralyzing perplexity, "You gotta be a good man! But many good guys gotta die sooner than others! Nah..?" he hollered in great merriment over his own humor. "Enjoy the night, goodbye!" he rather guffawed out the farewell to me. I smiled weakly back at him and slowly moved out. The goon leaned out of the entrance to watch me, still giggling. About twenty yards ahead the road turned right, and if I was able to round that corner I would finally move out of his sight. I watched many movies and read many thrillers where the villains appeared to be very suave, sophisticated and benevolent, but at the climax they used to murder the victims mercilessly. Those twenty yards seemed to be an eternity as I started moving slowly ahead measuring every step and at the same time keeping an absolute outward calm..."

title: The Guardians of Evil
author: Baby Kattackal
description: The Guardians of Evil is a meaningful novel that delves deep into the eddy vortex and furtive swirls of evils that struggle to find its natural outward flow from beneath his civilised exterior, his cultural pretentions.. More often than not, the stealthy goings on in the modern society behind the smoky, misty, curtain of a cultural living, steam out from under, in the form of gruesome violence. This is the atavistic spectral return of man's instinctive natural, savage characteristics, with callous disdain to the codes of virtues and morality, his adopted characteristics. This is the fight of man against himself.The fight between the savage man and the modern man of virtues had started ever since and non stop from the dawn of civilization. The answer to the question ""Who are the guardians of evil to stay on in the modern society?"" is man, man alone and nothing but man.- the rulers, the ruled and those incumbents saddled with the duty of keeping the rule of law and social well-being intact. . Author

title: Trapped
author: Kriza Mae Espinoza, Micaella Abatayo
description: North America is in danger, but first, let them be trapped! The group of excellent researchers fights fiercely in their quest, to meet the GEA Corporation! Group of Excellent Agents (GEA Corporation) is under HOME OF EXCELLENT AGENT where those chosen eloquent researchers, broadcasters, writers, and reporters are present in that Corporation. Mikasa Claymore desperately fulfills her ambition to become the best in the field of research and journalism. Even though her parents are against that, she pursues her dreams and he leaves her parents for that reason. That's why she did her best to become the best agent in GEA Corporation. There's a report that some ships were discovered completely abandoned for no apparent reason; others transmitted no distress signals and were never seen or heard from again. Aircraft have been reported and then vanished, and rescue missions are said to have vanished when flying in the area of that sea. Since they are excellent agents, they will be assigned to this task. Together the GEA Corp will unravel supernatural mysteries that haunt the ships cross in that sea areas. And soon they will discover an impending danger. Will they find out what it was? Let's be with the journey of Mikasa Claymore together with the GEA Team!

title: Adventures With Moti Uncle
author: Nimi Kurian
description: Keya and Dhruv love their Moti uncle. Whenever they are with him there is always mystery and excitement. He is neither young nor old, fat nor thin. He dabbles in science, astrology, history and more. Accompany this daring trio as they travel into the past and unravel dark secrets. In Sailing Away, Dhruv and Keya find themselves in the ocean and are rescued by a passing ship. But it's not just any old ship. It is a groaning, moaning, rattling heap. Things take on a dangerous twist and then its pirates and the slave trade, ambush and fighting. Never a dull moment. Moti uncle, Dhruv and Keya are enjoying a quiet, relaxing holiday in the Nilgiris. But on the last day, things turn topsy turvy and chaos reigns. They try to get to the bottom of this but they are not prepared for what they find. For that is Summer's Story. Wake up in the middle of the night to eerie music. The light, tinkling sound of a piano being played. Midnight Music keeps the trio awake at night with its ghostly melody. It is up to them to solve the puzzle. Join Moti uncle, Keya and Dhruv on their adventures and be a part of their exhilarating exploits.

title: Unforgiven
author: Colin Anderson
description: Rob is stuck in a loveless relationship, constantly belittled, put down and used... But he hides a dark secret, from his past, that is unleashed at all those who are against him... They push him too far.... And for there beytrayal they pay the ultimate price

title: Innocent Blood
author: Erodias Tombou Sobjio
description: INNOCENT BLOOD est un roman sociopolitique qui traite des sujets sur le terrorisme, les rebelles ( Boko Haram, Djihadistes, des gangsters, etc... dans les pays d'Afrique) le manuscrit parle également du conflit politique qui a eu lieu en RCA, opposant les anti-Balaka au Seléka. Il parle du Congo, du Mali, de la côte d'ivoire de la Mauritanie et de plusieurs autres pays victime des attentats terroristes. Ces 10 derniers années en Afrique. Il parle aussi de La précarité et fait une description détaillée et réaliste de la vie misérable en pays d'Afrique. pour le cas de ce livre, le drame est articulé autour de la crise anglophone qui sévit actuellement dans le NOSO, du Cameroun. C'est une histoire inspiré des faits réels entre le réalisme, la fiction et le métaphorique.

title: Fireflies from the Future
author: Abhishek Mittal
description: The year is 2027. A young politician leaves a failed political party in Delhi and moves down south to start her own outfit. At the same time, an engineer migrates back to India to start his own venture after his US company shuts down. As the two idealists follow their ambitions, they need to confront fickle loyalties of friends, the modern distorted forms of religion and hyper-nationalism, and the deep-rooted nexus between the political and corporate elite of the country which struggles to defeat the two rising contenders. It is an arduous but familiar road. Will they emerge victorious? Fireflies from the Future is an exploration of some of the most pressing issues of our times - climate change and religious polarisation - through the stories of its two protagonists, Nikitha and Vikram. Brimming with insights, ideas and revelations about contemporary India's politics and society, this book is sure to provide sufficient fodder for the mind.

title: Farming Life in Another World Volume 02
author: Kinosuke Naito
description: A host of new quirky characters flood the village in volume 2 of this slow-paced farming fantasy!The village is peaceful until a wyvern suddenly bursts onto the scene! Hiraku easily exterminates the fiend with the almighty farming tool, but news of this feat spreads like wildfire and draws many new guests to the village. The number of residents is steadily growing, all while Hiraku's first child is born! Get your almighty farming tools ready for Volume 2 of Farming Life in Another World!

title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship! (Manga) Vol. 3
author: Ryuto
description: THE BLOOD OF A…HIRO? Former corporate stooge Hiro is now living his best life in another universe! From touring a cultured meat factory with the harem of cuties to meeting a sexy doctor who is very into him, it seems like nothing could possibly go wrong. But then he finds out that he’s carrying a fortune in his bloodstream: human DNA from our universe is very rare in the star-spanning cosmos of SOL! Should Hiro sell out, or is his genetic sequence going to belong to the first person to get his, or her, hands on it?

title: Betrayed by the Hero, I Formed a MILF Party with His Mom! (Manga) Vol. 1
author: Ishino Yassan, Makoto Kuon
description: Ceres thought his life was over after being abruptly kicked out of the Hero's party by the arrogant Hero Zect. Alone and dejected, he stumbles upon an unusual slave market, where he finds none other than the Hero's own mother, Shizuko! Ceres has a thing for older women, and realizes that this is his chance to achieve a lifelong dream: Assembling a harem of MILFs!

title: HELP! I Got Sucked Into My Boyfriend's Fantasy Dungeons Fanfiction!
author: Minnie Rider
description: Some fantasies are better off staying private. At least, that was my first impression when I somehow got sucked into my boyfriend, James' fanfiction universe of his dumb game "Fantasy Dungeons" AKA "F-Dungeons". I mean, I got stuck as a succubus Healer, which must be the worst race and class and my luck keeps tanking on me. And did I mention he's not even a good writer? This world is full of plot holes! The more I see of this world, the more I'm convinced when I get home, I need to give James a good knock to the head with a feminist textbook! That is, if I can ever figure out how to get out of here with my limited Intelligence stats... Or I could dump him and the real world and stay with my harem of fantasy boyfriends... Slice of Life with Spice - this series is an Isekai LitRPG Romcom with polyamorous / reverse harem relationships packed with humour. This book contains adult content recommended for ages 18 and over.

title: Ao Haru Ride, Vol. 11
